images.caption:
Stingless jellyfish. 

Millions of this wonderful creature lives in Kakaban Lake, Kakaban island East Borneo, Indonesia. Kakaban in local means "hug" meaning the island hugging the lake from sea water. It's believed that this kind of jellyfish has evolved into non-stinging jellyfish because they were trapped in brackish water.
